issues.description: Import order violation: 'from conan.tools.meson' (line 14) appears before 'from conan.tools.layout' (line 15). Alphabetically, layout should precede meson. Rule 16 requires standard library → third-party → project internal with proper ordering.
issues.fix_suggestion: Reorder imports: swap lines 14-15 so that 'from conan.tools.layout import basic_layout' comes before 'from conan.tools.meson import Meson, MesonToolchain'.

issues.description: manifest.yaml uses 'software:' instead of 'name:' (line 1) and nested 'build.system:' instead of top-level 'build_system:' (line ~21). Code style rule 14 specifies fields name: and build_system: at top level. File header claims ARCHIVE-SPEC v2.0 which may define a different schema.
issues.fix_suggestion: If ARCHIVE-SPEC v2.0 mandates 'software'/'build.system', document the spec override. Otherwise, align with code style rule 14 by using 'name: flashrom' and 'build_system: meson' at top level.

issues.description: Hardcoded absolute paths for tc.ar and tc.strip ('/data/service/hnp/bin/llvm-ar' and '/data/service/hnp/bin/llvm-strip'). If the HarmonyOS HNP installation path changes, the build will fail without a clear error. While not a raw os.environ usage (R33), the fragility is similar.
issues.fix_suggestion: Consider using shutil.which('llvm-ar') with fallback to the hardcoded path, e.g.: tc.ar = shutil.which('llvm-ar') or '/data/service/hnp/bin/llvm-ar'.

issues.description: Comment '# R26: System-name libraries default to static' is misleading. R26 applies to system-name libraries (zlib/openssl/libxml2/ncurses). flashrom is not a system-name library, so R26 does not apply. The code itself (setting default_library based on shared option) is correct standard practice.
issues.fix_suggestion: Replace the comment with a more accurate description, e.g.: '# Set default_library based on shared option (static by default)'.

issues.description: package_type is 'library' while commands.json declares type 'tool'. flashrom provides both libflashrom (library) and flashrom CLI (tool). This is intentional since the primary Conan artifact is the library, but the dual nature could confuse reviewers without context.
issues.fix_suggestion: Add a brief comment near package_type, e.g.: '# library: primary artifact is libflashrom; flashrom CLI also installed (see commands.json)'.

summary: Audit of flashrom 1.6.0 adaptation PR (11 changed files, 2 rule files). P0 deception checks: PASS — test.c calls real flashrom_init/flashrom_shutdown API (not empty shell), sha256 is 64-hex non-trivial hash, status is 'built' (not faked as 'published'), no pre-compiled binaries, no #ifdef __OHOS__ stubs. P1 recipe correctness: PASS — conanfile.py uses MesonToolchain, meson.build(), basic_layout, sets tc.ar path, url non-empty, R32 platform check uses 'in' operator, official GitHub URL (github.com/flashrom/flashrom), Conan 2.x API, commands.json binary=true, manifest status='built', notes status='built', version 1.6.0 consistent across all files. P2 code style: 2 issues found — import order in conanfile.py (meson before layout) and manifest.yaml field naming (software/build.system vs name/build_system). P3 suggestions: 3 items — hardcoded ar/strip paths, misleading R26 comment, package_type vs commands.json type ambiguity. Verdict: PASS (no P0/P1 issues).
